description: The rural diesel pump is a Xingtai compact trailer: 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 15 MPa, horizontal 30–50 m, vertical 10–30 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, hopper 0.2 m³, 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm, 800 kg. Pipe DN is not printed. It is not Tractor-Driven 4100 and not a spraying machine.

answerBlock.what: Rural Diesel Concrete Pump is a compact diesel concrete pump for rural houses manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Catalogue parameters: 17 kW diesel, 5–8 m³/h, 15 MPa, horizontal 30–50 m, vertical 10–30 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, hopper 0.2 m³, 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm, 800 kg. Delivery pipe diameter is not printed. It is not Tractor-Driven 4100 and not a mortar spraying machine.
answerBlock.who: Rural house jobs matched to 5–8 m³/h, 15 MPa and 30–50 m / 10–30 m on an 800 kg diesel unit, with stone 1–3 cm.
factors: 17 kW / 5–8 m³/h / 800 kg versus Tractor-Driven 4100 at 40 kW / 6–12 m³/h / 1300 kg
Vertical cell is the range 10–30 m, not a single 30 m figure
Pipe DN is not on this sheet
SmartBuy mini band 10–30 m³/h and residential 30–60 m³/h do not replace 5–8 m³/h

faqs.question: Does the rural diesel pump print a delivery pipe diameter?
faqs.answer: No. The sheet prints 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 15 MPa, horizontal 30–50 m, vertical 10–30 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, hopper 0.2 m³, 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm and 800 kg. Pipe DN is not on that page. Straight pipe and hose are quoted after the pump model.

faqs.question: Is 5–8 m³/h inside the Alibaba SmartBuy mini-pump 10–30 m³/h band?
faqs.answer: SmartBuy describes mini pumps as about 10–30 m³/h and a residential FAQ as 30–60 m³/h. The rural diesel page prints 5–8 m³/h. The marketplace band does not rewrite the Xingtai cell.
